Current health and health since your 68th birthday questions, Q16-Q37. These are hospital admission for specific tests and treatments that were asked separately to the general hospital admssion question in Q38. Q's also asked in 2006-10.
cat_rows: Chest pain or heart disease admissions [510611]

This category contains data from the questionnaires on hospital admitted patient tests and treatments. This includes ECG, X-ray, angiogram, angioplasty and coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) operation questions.
